crusadecraft.resource.gold.desc: The crown's treasury, in gold coins. Taxes, the domain and deposits fill it; salaries, barracks upkeep and requests drain it. It may run into debt up to a limit.
crusadecraft.resource.prestige.desc: Earned through strong laws (high authority, chivalric code) and council meetings. Spent to force a rejected law and to promise honours. Debts erode it.
crusadecraft.resource.piety.desc: Brought by the chaplain ("Legitimacy" task) and prayers. It will fund crusades.
crusadecraft.resource.dread.desc: Reprimands, threats, prisons and exiles raise it. It weighs on council votes (a fearful councillor votes your way more readily) and drops by one point a day.
crusadecraft.tab.conseil.empty.title: No dignitary has been appointed yet.
crusadecraft.tab.conseil.empty.body: Sceptre in hand, sneak and right-click a citizen to offer them a council post or the mayorship of their colony.
crusadecraft.tab.vassaux.empty.title: No vassal has sworn fealty to you.
crusadecraft.tab.vassaux.empty.body: Colonies that join your realm, by oath or by conquest, will appear here with their contract.
crusadecraft.tab.diplomatie.empty.title: No other power is known.
crusadecraft.tab.diplomatie.empty.body: Realms you discover while exploring the world will appear here, with their opinion of you.
crusadecraft.tab.tresor.empty.title: The treasury is not kept yet.
crusadecraft.tab.tresor.empty.body: Soon, the Treasury Chest will hold the crown's gold, and your colonies' taxes will be counted there.
crusadecraft.tab.guerre.empty.title: The realm is at peace.
crusadecraft.tab.guerre.empty.body: Wars, their goals and their armies will be led from the War Table.
crusadecraft.tab.lois.empty.title: No law has been enacted yet.
crusadecraft.tab.lois.empty.body: Taxation and crown authority will be set here.
crusadecraft.tab.chroniques.empty.title: The chronicle of the reign begins.
crusadecraft.tab.chroniques.empty.body: Reigns, wars, successions and marriages will be written here on their own.
crusadecraft.map.soon: The realm map has not been drawn yet.

item.crusadecraft.sceptre.tooltip.2: Sneak + right-click: offer them a post.
item.crusadecraft.sceptre.tooltip.3: Right-click the air: the realm menu.
crusadecraft.trait.lache.desc: Prefers the shadows to the battlefield.
crusadecraft.trait.ambitieux.desc: Always aims higher, perhaps at your seat.
crusadecraft.trait.avare.desc: Counts every coin, and loves to be given some.
crusadecraft.trait.juste.desc: Believes the law applies to all.
crusadecraft.trait.arbitraire.desc: The law is whatever suits them.
crusadecraft.trait.confiant.desc: Readily believes what they are told.
crusadecraft.trait.colerique.desc: Flies into a rage at the slightest slight.
crusadecraft.trait.loyal.desc: Their word is worth any oath.
crusadecraft.trait.inconstant.desc: Changes sides at the drop of a hat.
crusadecraft.trait.blesse.desc: Still bears the marks of a fight.

crusadecraft.toast.gone.title: A dignitary has vanished
crusadecraft.toast.gone.body: %s, your %s, has left the colony. The post is vacant.
crusadecraft.action.reward.tip: Offer a gift, taken from the treasury (9 gold by default) or else from your inventory: their opinion of you rises for a while. A greedy one appreciates it all the more.
crusadecraft.action.reprimand.tip: Their opinion of you drops for a while; your dread rises a little.
crusadecraft.action.appoint.tip: Offer them a council post or the mayorship of their colony.
crusadecraft.action.imprison.tip: They lose their post and will resent you for a long time. Your dread rises.
crusadecraft.action.exile.tip: They lose their post and cannot serve during exile. They go on living in the colony.
crusadecraft.appoint.title: Which post for %s?
crusadecraft.dialogue.order.tip: Set their council task, or their mayor's office.
crusadecraft.dialogue.too_far: This citizen is too far away.
crusadecraft.dialogue.greeting.devoted: %s, it is always an honour to serve you.
crusadecraft.dialogue.greeting.friendly: %s, what can I do for you?
crusadecraft.dialogue.greeting.hostile: I have nothing to say to you, %s.
crusadecraft.dialogue.greeting.exiled: Even in exile, I remain within your call, %s.

crusadecraft.council.hint: To appoint someone: Sceptre in hand, sneak + right-click a citizen.

crusadecraft.task.gerer_la_cour.desc: Every day, the other dignitaries' opinion of you rises a little (stronger with a diplomatic chancellor).
crusadecraft.task.ameliorer_relations.de: Bring your realm closer to a neighbour.
crusadecraft.task.fabriquer_revendicatio: Give your realm rights over a neighbouring land.
crusadecraft.task.entrainer_troupes.desc: Every day, your colonies' guards gain Strength, Athletics, Agility and Dexterity experience (based on the marshal's Martial).
crusadecraft.task.maintenir_ordre.desc: Stifle revolts before they are born.
crusadecraft.task.gerer_le_domaine.desc: Every day, the domain brings gold to the crown, based on your population and the steward's Stewardship. Taxes also gain 1% per point of Stewardship.
crusadecraft.task.developper_province.de: Make a colony of the realm prosper.
crusadecraft.task.collecter_impots.desc: Taxes from all your colonies rise: +10%, plus 2% per point of the steward's Stewardship (instead of 1%).
The spymaster warns you when raiders are about to attack one of your colonies (more reliable the craftier they are).
crusadecraft.task.debusquer_complots.des: Uncover those who plot against you.
crusadecraft.task.legitimite.desc: Every day, the crown gains piety (based on the chaplain's Learning).
crusadecraft.task.bonheur_du_peuple.desc: Your citizens' happiness rises (MineColonies "Crown" modifier, based on the chaplain's Learning).

crusadecraft.request.ambition.title: A declared ambition

crusadecraft.treasury.salaries.tip: Councillors and mayors in office, paid every morning. Left unpaid, they will resent you.
crusadecraft.treasury.upkeep.tip: Barracks, guard towers, archery ranges, academies: their upkeep is due every day.
crusadecraft.treasury.hint: Deposits and withdrawals: at the Treasury Chest.
crusadecraft.treasury.deposit.tip: Pours every gold nugget, ingot and block from your inventory into the treasury.

crusadecraft.law.force.tip: Override the vote: you spend prestige, and those who voted against will resent you.

crusadecraft.law.realm_dormant: A dormant realm passes no laws.
crusadecraft.law.bad_level: This law level does not exist.
crusadecraft.law.already: This law is already in force.
crusadecraft.law.rejected: The council rejects it (%s for, %s against). Forcing it would cost %s prestige.
crusadecraft.law.no_prestige: You need %s prestige to force this law.
crusadecraft.law.forced: You force: %s, despite the council (%s for, %s against).
crusadecraft.law.fiscalite.legere.desc:
Taxes ×0.7.
MineColonies happiness rises ("Taxes" modifier).
Subjects are grateful (+5, +10 for the greedy).
crusadecraft.law.fiscalite.lourde.desc:
Taxes ×1.4.
MineColonies happiness drops ("Taxes" modifier).
Subjects resent you (−10, −15 for the greedy).
crusadecraft.law.autorite.aucune.desc:
Provinces only pay 60% of their taxes.
Dignitaries enjoy their freedoms (+10).
crusadecraft.law.autorite.elevee.desc:
Provinces pay all their taxes. +1 prestige a day.
Dignitaries grumble (−5, doubled for the ambitious).
Later: what you may demand of your vassals.
crusadecraft.law.autorite.absolue.desc:
Provinces pay 120% of their taxes. +2 prestige a day.
Dignitaries worry (−15, doubled for the ambitious, halved for the loyal).
crusadecraft.law.code_chevaleresque.proc:
The marshal's guard training yields 50% more experience.
+1 prestige a day.
The brave love it (+10), cowards do not (−10).
crusadecraft.law.justice_royale.coutumie: Each place judges by its own custom.
crusadecraft.law.justice_royale.royale.d:
Your verdicts are law: dread fades half as fast.
The just approve (+10), the arbitrary do not (−10).
crusadecraft.research.gouvernance.name: Governance
crusadecraft.research.effect.chancelleri: CrusadeCraft: unlocks high crown authority and royal justice (and, later, the Chancery)
crusadecraft.research.effect.chevalerie: CrusadeCraft: unlocks the chivalric code (and, later, the Tournament Lists)
